quest.title: Boom Boom Boooom! A Grand Battle!
quest.description: The time you agreed upon with Jahoda has arrived. You wonder if she brings good news...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Legion Morale x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

chapter.title: Boom Boom Boooom! A Grand Battle!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe, sweet, sweet Mora... Oh, ahem! Thank you for your patronage!

talks.objective: Go to the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hello. I appreciate you looking after Aino these past few days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it was nothing. A promise is a promise, right? Anyway, is Jahoda here? She probably has a bunch of new clues for us.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Let me explain.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: After I got back from the Frostmoon Scions, I started doing some digging into that merchant, Asikko. The fact that he outright tried to buy Aino's bot definitely makes him suspicious, but...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Even after asking around my boss's circle, I couldn't find any evidence that connects him to this mess. Out of all the merchants we met, he has the cleanest record.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I checked all the other merchants too, but the trail came up cold each time. Most of 'em didn't even know about our trip to the Frostmoon Scions.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoever's behind this thing is extremely clever. Covered their tracks perfectly...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tracking down a person like that is gonna take a lot more than two days...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you're saying...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Summarizing intel.... Condensing main points... Conclusion: Over the past two days, Jahoda has found no useful information.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Did you have to make it sound so pathetic? How am I gonna explain this to the kid...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So there's really nothing we can do?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I mean, short of rounding up those merchants, interrogating them, and searching their private warehouses for ourselves... Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sounds like a good idea to me.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That wasn't a suggestion... These aren't the type of people you mess with on a whim. I'd turn all of Nod-Krai upside down searching before I went after a man like Asikko.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: "Turning all of Nod-Krai upside down"... That is indeed Aino's backup plan.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay, well, I wasn't serious about that suggestion either.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: If that is what Aino decides to do in the end, then I will support her.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I've been thinking things over a lot since I got back, and the truth is... I can see why Krum-Clank's technology is being targeted by those chumps.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But that means... Any of my bots could be next, including Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: If we don't get Krum-Clank back, if we don't show them we're not an easy target, then there's nothing stopping them from coming after the rest of my robo-friends.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, even if I really do have to turn all of Nod-Krai upside down, I will save Krum-Clank, no matter what it takes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You said Asikko was the biggest suspect, right? Let's start with him, then!

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep beep... Bee-eep.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #...Someone sent a letter. It appears to be for you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Let's take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would recognize that tone anywhere... It's her, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep. It's Dori.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Seems like she has a way to help us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dori's services... are usually a bit more complicated than that.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ah, I've heard of her... She's got quite a... unique reputation around Nod-Krai.

choices.text: Well, let's at least talk to her.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hm... Alright, I'm down with that! You're in charge of the workshop, Ineffa! This time, we'll get Krum-Clank back for sure!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Very well. Please continue to look out for Aino in my stead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're coming too, Jahoda? You care too much about Aino to let this go, huh...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: *sigh*... More like, you're not the only one who's got a stupid robot asking you for favors.

choices.text: It's better than going on a wild goose chase around Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like that old man isn't here this time...
#Ah, look what the cat dragged in! {NICKNAME}, Paimon... I see you got my letter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dori! So it was you!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: My assistant told me about your little visit two days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Rumor has it, some terrible thief broke into the Krumkake Craftshop and ran off with one of Miss Aino's most treasured companions!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yes! That's exactly right!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: #You must know how much I value you as a customer, {NICKNAME}. So, I thought, if you've set out to help Miss Aino, I should do my part, too.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I did some digging, and I do believe I've come up with the perfect plan!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: There are too many merchants targeting that bot to root out the thief by going after them one by one. So, how about approaching this from a different angle?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Maybe the question we should be asking isn't "who stole the bot," but "where the thief took it in the first place"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, she has a point...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe! And lucky for you, I happen to know just the expert to help us out! She's been working smuggling cases for years. If you need to track down stolen merchandise, she's your gal!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Of course, a professional of her caliber demands quite a high retainer.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: But, not to worry! I can offer you a twenty percent discount!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: How about this... You give me the funds in advance — discount applied, of course — and I'll contact the expert. See if we can't bring that price down a little. I'm all about client convenience, as I'm sure you all know!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And, if she sympathizes with our cause and ups the discount, we'll call the difference... a little something for my trouble. Sound good?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just tell us how much you want.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Twenty percent off would be... 800,000 Mora. Do we have a deal?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 800,000... Can't you go any lower?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: If only I could... But there has to be room for me to take a cut, now, doesn't there?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: 800,000 Mora is worth it if it means we get Krum-Clank back! It's fine, I'll cover it!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Splendid! I'll contact the expert right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if you're okay with it, Aino, then the sooner we talk to this expert, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Great news! The expert is already in the area! I hope you have a productive conversation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, a Melusine? That's Sedile from Merusea Village!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Fancy seeing you here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, a Melusine?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? I've heard so much about you, but I didn't expect Nod-Krai to be the place we'd meet. I'm Sedile.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So, the expert is a Melusine? I've heard about these creatures before. They have special senses, right? They can pick up on things humans would never even notice.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Really? That sounds amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: With her help, we'll get leads on Krum-Clank for sure. Guess the price of the retainer was worth it, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, there's something you should know about Dori...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Retainer? What retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} is a hero to the Melusines. It's an honor to help {M#him}{F#her} out! I would never ask for even a single Mora in return.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: #Oh, wow! I didn't realize this expert idolized you so much, {NICKNAME}! Well, since she won't accept payment, I suppose there's no choice but for the entire 800,000... to go to me!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe, as always, I appreciate your patronage! Although, I guess this turn of events is all thanks to your past heroics...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: In that case... I'll give you a generous fifty percent off the next time we do business!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And the swindler claims another victim... Anyway, what are you doing in Nod-Krai, Sedile?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Well, one of the Melusine agents from the Marechaussee Phantom followed the trail of a smuggling case straight to Nod-Krai, but she still hasn't made it back to Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: We all started to get worried, and I happened to have some time off, so I'm here to check up on her.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: But enough about that for now. This merchant told me you needed help tracking down your missing companion?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Could you describe them to me? The more details, the better. Then, would it be possible to take me to the last place you saw them?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sure thing!

talks.objective: Go to the place where the recon bot disappeared

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, this is the last place we saw Krum-Clank. I remember that the recon bot disappeared right over there.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Hm... I've learned a little about those flying machines since I've been here. Their battery life isn't very long. Flying all the way out here is probably their limit.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: So, someone must have been in the vicinity to pick it up. We should ask around. Maybe someone saw something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, there's a group of people over there! Let's ask them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello! We wanted to ask something...

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Boss
dialogues.text: Looking for trouble, kid? No? Then scram.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Not a good start...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Legally speaking, even suspects have the right to remain silent. We can't force them to answer our questions.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's what you're worried about? Well, it's your lucky day. There's no law in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Clink Clank Legion, attack!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Under Aino's "interrogation," the man finally agrees to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Boss
dialogues.text: Fine, fine! If you wanna talk, then let's talk! Ask me anything you wanna know!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Ahem... Have you seen a group of people carrying a heavy object pass through here? If so, which direction did they go in?

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Boss
dialogues.text: I see that pretty much on the daily, and multiple times at that...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Hmm... If we think about when they started the look-out versus when they managed to get away...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: It would have been two days ago, between 4:00 and 10:00 PM. We're looking for anyone in the vicinity who left with a heavy object in tow.

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Boss
dialogues.text: Huh, when you put it that way... I did see a group like that. Real shifty looking. Came in the afternoon, left at night... I'm pretty sure they were heading in that direction.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: That direction... Hmm. If they knew that their cargo was being targeted by other merchants, they were probably trying to get out of here without being seen. That limits their options. Not to mention how cumbersome it would have been...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: I think I know where they were heading.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is the place? But there's no one here.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Assuming their stamina is within the range of a normal adult, if we factor in the weight of their cargo, they would have had to stop here and rest.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Which means there should be quite a few traces around here.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Traces? What kind of traces? This place just looks like a random stretch of wilderness...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Oh, there's a whole bunch! Here, and over there... Oh, it might be hard for you humans to pick up on. If I point them out, could you help me investigate?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This is the recon bot from that day! But, Krum-Clank isn't here...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Yep... Pretty much what I expected. When they made their initial escape, they took the recon bot with them to cover their tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: But it's exhausting to travel with that kind of cargo. So, once they made it far enough, they dropped the recon bot and ran off with Krum-Clank. I doubt they expected anyone to search this area.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: I bet these footprints are from when they fled this location.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Is that enough to tell where they went?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Hmm... Enough to give us some clues, at least. I see a special kind of sand in the footprints. It clearly isn't from any of the areas we've passed through so far.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: If I'm right, they probably tracked the sand in from somewhere else... somewhere they go a lot... like their hideout.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A special kind of sand... Wait, near the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle, there's a place called Maroon Basin. There's a huge beach there!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Then that's where we should head next.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wow, Melusines are awesome! I want one!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Melusines are people, not pets, Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's the last clue we needed, right? Let's get going!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: We were right! There's a camp here! But I don't see Krum-Clank anywhere. Maybe he's inside?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: With this many people standing guard, breaking in seems out of the question...

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, everyone, but I think this is as far as I can go. There's not much I can help you with in there.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Don't be sorry, Sedile! You've been such a big help, I wouldn't even mind sharing some of my secret dessert stash with you!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And, anyway, you probably shouldn't be here for this part, because I'm about to do something bad, and you're too good for that.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Hm... Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Like I said before, I'm the boss of the Krumkake Craftshop, and I'm gonna save my friend no matter what it takes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Who took down these branches? Did someone start a fire?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, we're in! Wait, what's that?
*rumble*

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whatever it is, it doesn't look friendly. Hold on...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This hunk of metal has Krum-Clank's core! The thief already took him apart!
Haha, quite the improvement, don't you think? My creation is ten times more powerful than your little toy. Can't say I'm surprised... That's what a true genius can do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're that guy from the black market! The one at the front desk! You're the one behind all this?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: If your goal is to accomplish something that will shock the world, you're better off working behind the scenes.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: I must admit, though... I'm rather surprised you made it this far. I expected you to spend more time fixating on those merchants...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You deliberately tried to steer us in the wrong direction!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: What, you never questioned the fact that the first notice you found just so happened to have the clues you were searching for?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: The front desk is where people go to exchange information. But I get to decide what to put front and center. The person who controls the information controls the people who seek it.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So, you're the one who stole Krum-Clank... both times?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: So what if I am?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: There's only one rule in Nod-Krai — winner takes all. With this prototype, the Mora I earn will put me on equal footing with the other factions. Then, no one — not even you — will be able to say a word against me!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Just using a piece of tech you stole from Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Stole? No, rescued! I'm taking advantage of its wasted potential!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Ever since learning about kuuvahki, I knew there was huge potential for machine integration! But no one saw my vision...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: I came all this way, but the stubborn natives refused to even entertain my ideas. It didn't go any better with the Fatui and their monopoly on kuuvahki research.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: But then this stupid girl who spends all her time making useless toys opens a workshop, and all the factions of Nod-Krai practically grovel at her feet!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: She's the one who gets to make a ground-breaking machine that has the potential to reshape the entire market...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: That role... should have been mine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, cause it's definitely not embarrassing to have beef with a kid...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That's enough! Give Krum-Clank back to us, right now!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: We'll see about that!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I'll keep watch over the workshop. Once again, I leave Aino to you.

dialogues.speaker: Modified Krum-Clank 70% Sweet
dialogues.text: Hum... Hum...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: What's happening? I... I need an engineer over here! Quick, fix it!

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: I... The core stopped working. It's supposed to concentrate kuuvahki, but it looks like it needs a specific transmission medium to operate...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: What kind of medium?

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: Judging by the smell, I'd say some kind of... dessert?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: What was that!?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Don't sound so surprised. Krum-Clank is a dessert-baking robot, but I always thought it would be too sad if he had to watch other people eat all the time without joining in.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So when I designed Krum-Clank, I gave him the ability to eat desserts too, not just bake them.

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: I think I understand now. The consumption of a cake-like dessert is required to keep the core's kuuvahki concentration function operating.

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: If cake-baking is the goal, that kind of system is sustainable.

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: But, to use it as a weapon, not even Nod-Krai's entire flour and sugar production would be enough to generate the required amount of power...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: And you're just noticing this now? Well then, get rid of that stupid function! Make it run on something else!

dialogues.speaker: Technician
dialogues.text: Boss, it's embedded into the system. I'm not skilled enough to change something like that. I didn't even notice it at first...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: See? Krum-Clank isn't a war machine. Now, give him back.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: This technology could have been revolutionary. It was supposed to be my big break! And now it's trapped in some useless kitchen bot all because of your stupid, childish idea!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: No. The prototype stays with me. I just need to hold out until I can secure an investment... Someone, get back the prototype!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Try me, you stupid...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! What are you all doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Protecting the Krumkake Craftshop is a job for all who call it home. Activating annihilation mode...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (A stove? Looks like someone did start a fire here to cook something...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! He got away!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let him run for now. Nod-Krai doesn't have laws, but it does have rules. Once word starts to spread about what happened here, he'll get what's coming to him.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Is everyone alright? Apparently, Nod-Krai doesn't have a police force, so I contacted your friends for help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, way to think ahead, Sedile!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wait, what about Krum-Clank?

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: ...Miss Aino, during the altercation, my brethren and I retrieved the core from that construct. It should go to its rightful owner. I apologize for thinking otherwise before.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: This technology needs safekeeping, and I think... No, I know that it's safest in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And I know you're not the bad guys I thought you were, so... Enough with all the mushy stuff, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Let's go home, Ineffa. Oh, and when we get back, I want dessert! I think my monthly quota deserves to be reset, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, it's been two days. Let's head to the workshop and see if Jahoda found any new clues.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is that Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's Zip-Zap War-Bot Number 1, now!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. War-bot? I knew the kid was making dangerous stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: With Zip-Zap War-Bot on our side, there's no stopping us! C'mon, charge!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Wh—What is this thing? Help! Somebody help me!

dialogues.speaker: Feigning-Calm Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: What are you running for? Just take it down! There's nothing scary about— Ahhh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is this machine so powerful?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I can't even hit the thing!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No, you guys, don't attack him! We just have to wait it out!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'm not letting Krum-Clank become a war machine!
